title: Link join request
description: The body of the session's POST to <run.url>/<run_id>/sessions on its gateway's link, application/json, which joins a session to the open run: the names of the variables the session passes a value for and, optionally, the model key the session starts with. Behind a separate gateway the request carries the run's run key, whose run the run_id of the path must be, any other run_key_invalid. A body this schema refuses, a member it does not define among them, is invalid_request; a placeholder of a credential or a tool the gateway holds among passes is placeholder_conflict, a 403, and the run stays open; a join of a run that has ended is a 410.

version.description: The document format. The gateway reads version 1 alone.

passes.description: The names of the variables the session passes a value for: what it inherits, what the harness sets and its variables. Names alone, never a value. The gateway answers the join with placeholder_conflict, a 403, when a placeholder of a credential or a tool it holds for the run is among them. An empty list passes none.

model_credential.description: The name of the model key the session starts with, one of the model keys the gateway holds for the run, from the server or the machine. Absent means the run's start key, the run answer's model_credential. A name of no model key of the run is invalid_request.
